article.title: Israel’s “opposition” offers genocide with better PR
article.author: Editor
article.content: Israel's election produced no real alternative for Palestinians, because every Zionist party from Eisenkot's Yashar to Golan's Democrats shares the same commitment to apartheid, occupation, and genocide. The post Israel’s “opposition” offers genocide with better PR appeared first on MR Online .
